import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(r"\s*(a|b|TMP)\s*<-\s*(a|b|TMP|-?\d+)\s*;\s*")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        target, source = match.groups()
        values[target] = values[source] if source in ("a", "b", "TMP") else int(source)

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
